mentions.name: Multipark Amsterdam
mentions.description: This iOS app helps drivers in Amsterdam guarantee parking near a destination: the user pinpoints a point on the map inside a friend's geofenced visitor parking zone, and the app automatically selects and reserves a nearby parking meter so they can park almost instantaneously. It was recently updated to work with new APIs and received a slightly modernized UI.
mentions.problem: When visiting a place near a friend's visitor parking zone in Amsterdam, it's hard to be 100% sure you can park at your chosen spot and to secure a meter there instantly.
mentions.audience: People in Amsterdam who have access to a friend's visitor parking account (mostly friends with free accounts)
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://apps.apple.com/nl/app/multipark-amsterdam/id6746983573

Use Case: Assumption: You have access to your friends visitor parking login in Amsterdam.

You are going to a restaurant/or visiting a place near their parking zone(geo fenced polygon). You want to pinpoint a point in map and drive to that point. Being 100% sure that you can park at that point. Automatically pick a meter near there spot and park almost instantaneously.

mentions.name: MultiPark Amsterdam
mentions.description: This iOS app helps drivers park in Amsterdam's visitor parking zones. Users pinpoint a destination point on the map within a geo-fenced parking zone, and the app automatically picks a nearby parking meter so they can drive to that spot and park almost instantaneously, certain that parking is available there. It works with a friend's visitor parking account login.
mentions.problem: When visiting a place in Amsterdam, you cannot be sure you can park at the spot you pick; the app removes that uncertainty by automatically selecting a meter near the destination so parking is nearly instantaneous.
